local resetButton = makeButton("Reset", UDim2.new(0.5, 5, 0, 135), Color3.fromRGB(150, 60, 60))

local createdOverlays = {}

	status.TextColor3 = color or Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 190)
end

	return string.match(text, "%d+")
end

local function applyImage(id)
	local assetUrl = "rbxassetid://" .. id
	local count = 0

	for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if obj:IsA("Texture") or obj:IsA("Decal") then
			local part = obj.Parent
			if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then
				if obj.Transparency > 0 then
					local overlay = Instance.new("Decal")
					overlay.Name = "ReplacerOverlay"
					overlay.Face = obj.Face
					overlay.Texture = assetUrl
					overlay.Transparency = 0
					overlay.Color3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
					overlay.Parent = part
					table.insert(createdOverlays, overlay)
				else
					table.insert(originalTextures, { obj = obj, texture = obj.Texture })
					obj.Texture = assetUrl
				end
				count += 1
			end
		end
	end

	return count
end

local function resetAll()
	for _, data in ipairs(originalTextures) do
		if data.obj and data.obj.Parent then
			data.obj.Texture = data.texture
		end
	end
	table.clear(originalTextures)

	for _, overlay in ipairs(createdOverlays) do
		if overlay then
			overlay:Destroy()
		end
	end
	table.clear(createdOverlays)
end

local function SendChat(msg)
    if not msg or msg == "" then return false end

    -- 新チャット (TextChatService)
    local ok = pcall(function()
        if TextChatService.ChatVersion == Enum.ChatVersion.TextChatService then
            local channel = TextChatService.TextChannels:FindFirstChild("RBXGeneral")

                return

    end)

    local msg = PHRASES[Settings.Index]
    Settings.Index = Settings.Index + 1

-- Cherry's Club | The Nightmare Locust (V22 - Smooth & Reactive)
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")

local MODEL_ID = "85434241672934" 
local currentModel = nil
local rootPart = nil
local bones = {}
local walkPhase = 0
local twitchPhase = 0
local breathPhase = 0
local rayParams = RaycastParams.new()

-- ============================================================
-- AUDIO
-- ============================================================
local AUDIO_URL = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/michineitorxd3000-coder/idk-bro-locust/main/Locustadiotrack.mp3.mp3"
local FOLDER_NAME = "LocustAudio"
local FILE_NAME = "Locustadiotrack.mp3"
local FILE_PATH = FOLDER_NAME .. "/" .. FILE_NAME

local function setupAudio()
    if not writefile or not isfolder or not isfile or not getcustomasset then return "rbxassetid://131961136" end
    if not isfolder(FOLDER_NAME) then makefolder(FOLDER_NAME) end
    if not isfile(FILE_PATH) then
        local success, response = pcall(function() return game:HttpGet(AUDIO_URL) end)
        if success and response then writefile(FILE_PATH, response) else return "rbxassetid://131961136" end
    end
    local assetSuccess, assetId = pcall(function() return getcustomasset(FILE_PATH) end)
    return assetSuccess and assetId or "rbxassetid://131961136"
end

local customSoundId = setupAudio()
local screechSound = Instance.new("Sound")
screechSound.SoundId = customSoundId
screechSound.Volume = 3 
screechSound.Pitch = 0.8 
screechSound.RollOffMaxDistance = 120
screechSound.Parent = SoundService

local function playScreech()
    if not screechSound.IsPlaying then
        task.delay(math.random(0, 50) / 100, function() if not screechSound.IsPlaying then screechSound:Play() end end)
    end
end

-- ============================================================
-- SPAWN (True Morph)
-- ============================================================
local function spawnModel()
    if currentModel then currentModel:Destroy(); currentModel = nil end
    bones = {}
    
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hrp or not hum then return end

    local animateScript = char:FindFirstChild("Animate")
    if animateScript then animateScript:Destroy() end
    local animator = hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
    if animator then for _, track in ipairs(animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do track:Stop() end end

    -- Ocultar y destruir accesorios
    for _, obj in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
        if obj:IsA("Accessory") or obj:IsA("Shirt") or obj:IsA("Pants") or obj:IsA("ShirtGraphic") then
            obj:Destroy()
        end
    end

    local success, model = pcall(function() return game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://" .. MODEL_ID)[1] end)
    if not success or not model then return end

    for _, obj in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
            obj.Anchored = true
            obj.CanCollide = false
        elseif obj:IsA("Script") or obj:IsA("LocalScript") then
            obj:Destroy()
        end
    end

    model.Name = "NightmareLocust"
    model.Parent = workspace
    currentModel = model
    model:ScaleTo(0.05) 

    rootPart = model:FindFirstChild("RootPart", true) or model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
    if not rootPart then return end
    model.PrimaryPart = rootPart

    for _, obj in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("Bone") then
            bones[obj.Name] = { bone = obj, restCFrame = obj.CFrame }
        end
    end

    rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { char, currentModel }
    rayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    playScreech()
end

-- ============================================================
-- LOOP PRINCIPAL
-- ============================================================
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
    if not currentModel or not rootPart then return end
    
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hrp or not hum then return end

    -- Invisibilidad
    for _, part in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
        if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
            part.Transparency = 1
            part.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
        end
    end

    local speed = hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude * hum.WalkSpeed
    local moving = speed > 0.1
    
    -- Variables de reacción
    local lightReaction = 0
    local isScaredOfLight = false

    if moving then
        walkPhase = walkPhase + dt * (speed * 0.25) -- Más lento = más fluido
        twitchPhase = twitchPhase + dt * 15
        breathPhase = breathPhase + dt * 4
        if math.random() > 0.98 then playScreech() end
    else
        walkPhase = 0
        breathPhase = breathPhase + dt * 1.5
        twitchPhase = twitchPhase + dt * (math.random() > 0.9 and 20 or 2)
        if math.random() > 0.995 then playScreech() end
    end

    -- ============================================================
    -- REACCIÓN A LA LUZ (Si hay una linterna cerca, se asusta)
    -- ============================================================
    for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("SpotLight") or obj:IsA("PointLight") then
            if obj.Enabled and obj.Brightness > 1 then
                local dist = (obj.Parent.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude
                if dist < 25 then -- Si la luz está a menos de 25 studs
                    isScaredOfLight = true
                    lightReaction = math.clamp(1 - (dist / 25), 0, 1) -- Más cerca = más reacción
                end
            end
        end
    end

    if isScaredOfLight and math.random() > 0.9 then
        playScreech() -- Chilla si le da la luz
    end

    -- ============================================================
    -- MATEMÁTICAS DE SUELO (Sin rotar hacia adelante)
    -- ============================================================
    local baseOffset = -3.0 -- Subimos un poco el cuerpo para que no toque el suelo
    local rayOrigin = hrp.Position
    local floorHit = workspace:Raycast(rayOrigin, Vector3.new(0, -10, 0), rayParams)
    
    if floorHit then
        local distanceToFloor = (hrp.Position.Y - floorHit.Position.Y)
        baseOffset = -distanceToFloor + 0.5 
    end

    local ceilingRay = workspace:Raycast(hrp.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0), Vector3.new(0, 6, 0), rayParams)
    if ceilingRay then baseOffset = baseOffset - 0.5 end

    -- SWAY (Balanceo natural del cuerpo)
    local sway = moving and math.sin(walkPhase) * math.rad(3) or 0
    local bob = moving and ((math.sin(walkPhase * 2) * 0.2) - 0.2) or 0

    rootPart.CFrame = hrp.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, baseOffset + bob, 0)

    local function applyBone(name, rotOffset)
        local bData = bones[name]
        if bData then bData.bone.CFrame = bData.restCFrame * rotOffset end
    end

    -- ============================================================
    -- POSTURA (Menos inclinado, más fluido)
    -- ============================================================
    local breath = math.sin(breathPhase) * math.rad(2)
    
    -- Si tiene miedo a la luz, se echa hacia atrás. Si no, camina normal.
    local huntPose = 0
    if isScaredOfLight then
        huntPose = math.rad(15) * lightReaction -- Se arquea hacia atrás
    else
        huntPose = moving and math.rad(-15) or math.rad(-5) -- Menos inclinado
    end
    
    -- Aplicamos Sway a la columna
    applyBone("spine", CFrame.Angles(huntPose + sway + breath, 0, 0))
    applyBone("spine.001", CFrame.Angles(sway + breath, 0, 0))
    applyBone("spine.002", CFrame.Angles(sway, 0, 0))
    
    -- Joroba suave
    local hunch = isScaredOfLight and math.rad(5) or math.rad(-10)
    applyBone("spine.003", CFrame.Angles(hunch + breath, 0, 0))
    applyBone("spine.004", CFrame.Angles(hunch, 0, 0))
    applyBone("spine.005", CFrame.Angles(hunch, 0, 0))

    -- CABEZA (Mira a los lados suavemente)
    local headTwitch = math.sin(twitchPhase * 1.5) * math.rad(8)
    local neckTwitch = math.cos(twitchPhase * 0.8) * math.rad(4)
    applyBone("spine.006", CFrame.Angles(hunch + neckTwitch, headTwitch, 0))

    -- ============================================================
    -- PIERNAS (Animación de paso suave, sin rigidez)
    -- ============================================================
    if moving then
        local function getLegRotations(phase)
            -- Usamos una onda senoidal más suave
            local s = math.sin(phase)
            local c = math.cos(phase)
            
            -- Pasos más largos y suaves
            local thighRotX = s * math.rad(45)
            -- La rodilla se dobla suavemente
            local kneeRotX = (s > 0) and -(s * math.rad(60)) or -math.rad(15)
            
            -- Un pequeño balanceo lateral en la cadera (Sway de piernas)
            local thighRotZ = c * math.rad(5)

            return CFrame.Angles(thighRotX, 0, thighRotZ), CFrame.Angles(kneeRotX, 0, 0)
        end

        local rThigh, rKnee = getLegRotations(walkPhase)
        local lThigh, lKnee = getLegRotations(walkPhase + math.pi)

        applyBone("thigh.R", rThigh)
        applyBone("thigh.L", lThigh)
        applyBone("shin.R", rKnee)
        applyBone("shin.L", lKnee)

        local function getFootAngle(phase)
            local s = math.sin(phase)
            return CFrame.Angles(s * math.rad(20), 0, 0)
        end
        applyBone("foot.R", getFootAngle(walkPhase))
        applyBone("foot.L", getFootAngle(walkPhase + math.pi))
    else
        -- Quieto (Respirando y con miedo a la luz)
        local idleThigh = isScaredOfLight and math.rad(10) or math.rad(20)
        applyBone("thigh.R", CFrame.Angles(idleThigh, 0, 0))
        applyBone("thigh.L", CFrame.Angles(idleThigh, 0, 0))
        applyBone("shin.R", CFrame.Angles(-math.rad(30), 0, 0))
        applyBone("shin.L", CFrame.Angles(-math.rad(30), 0, 0))
        applyBone("foot.R", CFrame.Angles(math.rad(10), 0, 0))
        applyBone("foot.L", CFrame.Angles(math.rad(10), 0, 0))
    end

    -- ============================================================
    -- BRAZOS (Fluidos y con Raycast)
    -- ============================================================
    local armSwing = moving and math.sin(walkPhase + math.pi) * math.rad(15) or 0
    local tremble = math.sin(twitchPhase) * math.rad(1.5)
    
    -- Si tiene miedo a la luz, se cubre la cara con los brazos
    local coverFace = isScaredOfLight and math.rad(90) * lightReaction or 0

    local armL = CFrame.Angles(armSwing + tremble + math.rad(5) + coverFace, 0, math.rad(5))
    local armR = CFrame.Angles(-armSwing - tremble + math.rad(5) + coverFace, 0, math.rad(-5))

    local shoulderR = bones["shoulder.R"] and bones["shoulder.R"].bone.WorldPosition
    local shoulderL = bones["shoulder.L"] and bones["shoulder.L"].bone.WorldPosition

    if shoulderR then
        local hitR = workspace:Raycast(shoulderR, rootPart.CFrame.RightVector * 8, rayParams)
        if hitR then
            local lookDir = (hitR.Position - shoulderR).Unit
            armR = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(0,0,0), lookDir) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-90), 0, 0)
        end
    end
    if shoulderL then
        local hitL = workspace:Raycast(shoulderL, -rootPart.CFrame.RightVector * 8, rayParams)
        if hitL then
            local lookDir = (hitL.Position - shoulderL).Unit
            armL = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(0,0,0), lookDir) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-90), 0, 0)
        end
    end

    applyBone("upper_arm.R", armR)
    applyBone("upper_arm.L", armL)
end)

    task.wait(1)
    spawnModel()
end)
